The tomatoes came in late this year. It wasn't the soil. It was the long wet spring and a frost that held on into the first week of June, which nobody on the block remembers happening before.

So we waited. The peppers did fine, oddly, and the beans climbed the fence in about three weeks. I can't explain the peppers.

1. Water in the morning.
2. Mulch after the first hot week.

If the frost comes early again we'll cover the beds with the old sheets from the garage. That worked two years ago and it costs nothing at all.
